name: Maximum Projected Teaching Set Size / Projected Recursive Teaching Dimension
details: For every finite binary concept class, $\mathrm{TS}_{\max}^p(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{RTD}^p(\mathcal H)$. Equivalently, the star number upper-bounds projected recursive teaching dimension.
proof: For each coordinate projection $\mathcal H_{|S}$, recursive teaching dimension is at most teaching dimension, because a teaching set for every target in the full projected class is available at the first recursive stage.  Taking the maximum over $S$ gives $\max_S\mathrm{RTD}(\mathcal H_{|S})\leq\max_S\mathrm{TD}(\mathcal H_{|S})=\mathrm{TS}_{\max}^p(\mathcal H)$.
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, maximum projected teaching-set size (equivalently star number) is $n-1$, while projected recursive teaching dimension is $1$.
